o.text: From Russian гимн (gimn), Ancient Greek ῠ̔́μνος (hŭ́mnos).
Ultimately from Latin rhombus and Ancient Greek ῥόμβος (rhómbos, “rhombus, spinning top”).

Inherited from Proto-Turkic *tï̄t-.
Cognate with Turkish ditmek, Turkmen düýtmek and tüýtmek, Kyrgyz тытуу (tıtuu), Chuvash тат (tat).
